summary: American Water Capital Corp., a wholly owned finance subsidiary of American Water Works Company, filed an 8-K reporting the September 16, 2026 closing of a registered $500.0 million offering of 5.550% senior notes due 2033, sold under a September 14 underwriting agreement led by PNC Capital Markets, Mizuho, RBC and U.S. Bancorp. Net proceeds were approximately $496.6 million after underwriting discounts. Proceeds will repay $250.0 million of 3.000% notes due December 1, 2026, fund regulated-business lending, repay commercial paper and serve general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt takedown, not a special situation; watch refinancing costs and rate-base funding needs.
